name: easytouch-frontend
description: Dashboard frontend for easytouch. Bun bundles frontend/*.ts -> easytouch/static/app.js; the committed build output is what the Python server serves (no Node/Bun needed at runtime).

scripts.build: bun build frontend/app.ts --outfile easytouch/static/app.js --target browser --minify && cp frontend/index.html frontend/style.css easytouch/static/
